trial_court: Additional District Judge, Lakhnadaun, District Seoni in C.S. No.14-A/04
facts_of_case: Appellant-wife and respondent-husband are husband and wife. They have a daughter and a son. Appellant went to her maternal home but did not return back. Respondent filed application under Section 9 of Hindu Marriage Act for restitution of conjugal rights. Trial court allowed the application.

legal_principles.principle: The second illegal marriage of the husband itself is a proper ground to refuse to live with the husband.
legal_principles.held: In view of the above, it is clear that the respondent's second marriage is a sufficient reason for the appellant to refuse to live with him.
cited_cases: Smt.Santoshi Belwanshi vs Kop Singh on 8 February, 2018

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the respondent to prove that there is a proper reason for the appellant to live with him.
legal_principles.held: Therefore, it was directed to bring the documents on record along with affidavit of the appellant and it was also directed that appellant and respondent remain present before this Court on 26.04.2016

outcome.final_order: Decree under Section 9 of Hindu Marriage Act for restitution of conjugal rights has been passed against the appellant.

keywords: Latin maxim: 'Nemo dat quod non habet'
